title: Uncharted with Hannah Fry
summary: Hannah Fry follows the numbers on thrilling journeys of data and discovery.
author: BBC Radio 4

episodes.title: 20. The Confidence Trick
episodes.summary: An ambitious portfolio manager stumbles upon a perfect graph. It outlines eye watering profits. But something doesn't quite add up - could this graph be accurate? Or does it hide a far more sinister truth?

episodes.title: 1. The Returning Soldier
episodes.summary: It's 1973 and the UK is in crisis: runaway inflation, industrial strike action and political turmoil. Unnoticed at the time, something odd is happening in hospitals across the country.
